title: Prove the private weekday conversion and resume the original parser
description: Preserve the first frozen refusals, then check the actual fixed private conversion and bridge on every signed Java int. Compare both installed weekday strategies, prove exactly where they agree, and substitute each admitted result in two fresh continuations of every fixed public history. Bind the caller-owned calendar, cursor, both write sites, the initialized timezone provider and its sorted JDK data. Test withheld, corrupt and parent receipts. Retry the strict initializer on both original releases in ordinary and controlled processes.
